# MaterialX example materials

The 26 `.mtlx` files here are unmodified copies of the example materials of the MaterialX project (Academy Software
Foundation, Copyright Contributors to the MaterialX Project), tag v1.39.5,
https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/MaterialX/tree/v1.39.5/resources/Materials/Examples . Licence: Apache-2.0,
full text in LICENSE.txt beside them (the repository's LICENSE at that tag). Standard sample data only, used by
`packages/loaders/tests/materialx-reference.test.js`; never shipped in a package tarball. No MaterialX source code was
read or copied. Each Git blob id below equals the one GitHub lists for that path at v1.39.5.
